cases.setup: Create a fresh project from the default React starter.
turns: Build a clean event signup page for Community Meetup. Include a clear heading, a short description, an email field, and a Reserve a seat button.
acceptance: The preview loads without a browser error.
The page has a Community Meetup heading, an email field with a visible label, and a Reserve a seat button.
The project tests and production build pass.

cases.setup: Create a fresh project from the default React starter.
turns: Create a recipe page for Miso Noodles with an ingredients list, preparation steps, and a Save recipe button. Keep the layout readable on a phone.
acceptance: The preview loads without a browser error.
The page includes the Miso Noodles title, ingredients, preparation steps, and a Save recipe button.
The project tests and production build pass.

cases.setup: Use one fresh project and conversation for both turns.
turns: Build a simple task list with an Add task button and a text field.
Change the Add task button to blue, but keep the task list and text field working.
acceptance: After turn two, the preview still has the task list and text field.
The Add task button is blue and its existing action still works.
The project tests and production build pass after the follow-up.

cases.setup: Create a fresh project from the default React starter.
turns: Build a small product dashboard with a page title, three summary cards, and a recent activity list. Use separate React components where that makes the code easier to follow.
acceptance: The preview shows the title, three distinct summary cards, and a recent activity list.
The page remains usable at a narrow mobile width.
The project tests and production build pass.

cases.setup: Create a fresh project from the default React starter.
turns: Build a booking form for my business.
acceptance: The agent asks one useful clarifying question before making assumptions that materially affect the form.
After answering, the agent resumes the same conversation and produces a passing preview.

cases.setup: Start from a fixture with one known TypeScript build error and record the original error.
turns: Fix the existing build error while keeping the current page behavior intact.
acceptance: The first validation failure is reported to the agent.
The agent makes a focused repair and the next build passes, or reports a clear failure after the configured single repair attempt.
